title: Builder → Lead handoff
description: Schema for the JSON Builder writes to .agent-team/<run-id>/builder-<stack>.json when reporting done.

stack.description: Stack name. Conventional values: fe, be, data, mobile, infra. Lead substitutes into the filename.

branch.description: Feature branch name (e.g., feat/example-feature). Must match what Lead instructed.

tasks_done.description: Spec task numbers completed by this Builder.

tasks_open.description: Spec task numbers explicitly deferred or blocked. Empty array if all done.

files_changed.description: Relative paths from repo root for every file added/modified/deleted by this Builder.

tests.description: Test gate results. Keys are gate names; values are command + exit + duration. typecheck/lint/test are conventional; add others (build, e2e) as relevant.

tests_run.description: For 'test' gate only — total tests executed.

output_tail.description: Optional. Last 20 lines of stdout/stderr — useful for QA to verify on re-run.

notes.description: One-line summary of any non-obvious decisions, deferred items, or contract changes. Lead surfaces this in the PR body and to QA.

contract.description: Optional. For upstream Builders (data/backend) whose interface downstream Builders consume. Examples: API endpoints, function signatures, event shapes.

ready_for_qa.description: Must be true for Lead to advance to QA phase. False signals 'I'm done with my scope but explicitly blocked on tasks_open.'
